description: The Billing & limits and Activity & deletion pages use their own minimal header (secondary link + Back to files) with no account menu or sign-out. A person on a shared computer who lands on those pages must go back to the console to find the account control. In test-auth mode the console profile row is also plain text with no sign-out (expected; production Clerk UserButton not verifiable here).
expected: The account control (UserButton) available in the header of every signed-in page.
suggested_fix: Add the account menu to the shared header of the account pages.

description: The same pages have different names: sidebar 'Billing & limits' / 'Activity & deletion' versus header links 'Billing' / 'Settings' and the URL /console/settings.
suggested_fix: Rename the header links to match the sidebar labels.

description: On Activity & deletion the 'Delete one drive' and 'Delete your account' cards are different heights (446px vs 373px) and their form fields do not line up: the drive card has no description line, so its select (y~156) and the account card's input (y~218) sit at different heights.
expected: Aligned sibling cards, each with a short description.
actual: Misaligned fields and buttons across the two columns.
suggested_fix: Add a description to the drive card or align the grid rows.

description: The audit log's first rows are the console's own read calls (console.audit.list, drives.list, console.deletions.list by 'Console user'), generated by opening the page itself. They push meaningful agent events down.
expected: Filter console read calls by default or group them.
actual: Self-generated reads fill the first screen.
suggested_fix: Hide read-only console actions behind a 'Show console activity' toggle.
